programme.title: Animals Decoded – Cultural Diversity | S01E02

programme.title: Night in the forest

programme.title: Kielder Forests – Autumn | E03
programme.desc: Kielder Forest is the largest forest in England. The creators decided to take a closer look at the animals living there. We will learn how they adapt to the changing seasons. programme.title: African predators: the big four – Lycaons | E04

programme.title: Grizli: Queen of the Tetons

programme.title: Animals: masters of survival – Hunters | S01E05
programme.desc: Many animal species have developed unique survival skills through evolution. Viewers will meet twenty of their representatives in various survival categories. Viewers will learn fascinating hunting tactics, excellent teamwork and incredible speed, endurance and camouflage skills. They will see the 20 most dangerous animal predators. Great Britain. 2022. documentary series

programme.title: Extreme Life – Cold | E01
programme.desc: The series highlights a variety of incredibly resilient life forms that struggle to survive on our increasingly unpredictable planet. Are there limits to adaptation and survival? Episode description: Cold lands are very demanding territories, but also full of opportunities; only the most resilient creatures can survive in an environment where the key to survival is adaptability... Spain, Great Britain. 2024. documentary film

programme.title: Extreme Life – Wet | E02
programme.desc: Spain, Great Britain. 2024. documentary film

programme.title: Earth – planet of life – Planet of people | E05
programme.desc: Earth has survived countless collisions and disasters in the solar system. From asteroid impacts to volcanic eruptions and climate crises. The program will show what some of them looked like. Humans dominated the Earth very quickly. Despite being the dominant species, humans still need to be on guard. Humanity must watch out for threats from volcanoes and asteroids. Germany. 2023. documentary series

programme.title: Earth seen from space – Planet of changes | S01E04
programme.desc: A documentary series showing phenomena on Earth recorded by cameras in space. Will be shown, among others: great animal migrations, changes of seasons, sea tides and breathtaking neon lights of the northern lights. Cameras in space record changes taking place on Earth. Cities are growing rapidly, and the area of ​​forests and glaciers is decreasing alarmingly. The people of Tanzania decided to stop this process. They reclaimed land to save the chimpanzees. USA, Great Britain. 2019. documentary series

programme.title: In the air – First flight | E01

programme.title: Birds – Origin and flight | S01E01
programme.desc: The program contains the latest knowledge and discoveries about birds. Leading scientists have proven that these extraordinary creatures can sleep in flight, have dreams, have imagination and can think ahead. Each new fossil found provides researchers with further information about the history, origin and evolution of these animals. In this episode, viewers learn about the origins of birds. They will learn how they have evolved over the last 150 million years, survived asteroid impacts, and developed amazing energy-saving tactics. Great Britain. 2022. documentary series

programme.title: The natural world: mighty eagles
programme.desc: Eagles are characterized by a massive silhouette, as well as wide wings and large extended claws. This animal's structure makes it able to cope with huge prey. programme.title: Wings over water

programme.title: Time of Giants – 2

programme.title: New Zealand: Mythical Islands – Drift | E01
programme.desc: Viewers have the opportunity to better understand the nature and geographical conditions of the island chain, isolated from other ecosystems. The authors present unique regions of New Zealand. They also observe the everyday life and habits of the most tough and resistant inhabitants of this area. The local forests are inhabited by, among others: predators from the Jurassic period. Great Britain. 2016. documentary series

programme.title: New Zealand: Mythical Islands – Wildlife | E02
programme.desc: Viewers have the opportunity to better understand the nature and geographical conditions of the island chain, isolated from other ecosystems. The authors present unique regions of New Zealand. They also observe the everyday life and habits of the most tough and resistant inhabitants of this area. programme.title: 30 for 30: Long Gone Summer
programme.desc: 30 for 30 (Sports). As part of its 30th anniversary celebration, ESPN looks back at notable sports happenings that occurred from 1979 to 2009 with this documentary series featuring 30 films from some of Hollywood's finest directors and producers. Peter Berg, Barry Levinson, John Singleton, Spike Jonze, Dan Klores, Barbara Kopple, Ron Shelton and Albert Maysles are among the filmmakers involved, and the stories told include the shocking trade of Wayne Gretzky in 1988, the Baltimore Colts' nighttime move in 1984, Reggie Miller's rivalry with the New York Knicks, the death of Len Bias in 1986, a profile of George Steinbrenner and his family business, and a look at Michael Jordan's attempt at a baseball career. A new series of 30 films premiered in October 2012 with «Broke,» about the challenges athletes face in managing their money

programme.title: d/s On the verge of extinction. Australia

programme.title: d/f Hunters of the Mediterranean Sea
programme.desc: In the world of wildlife, every living creature is not just part of an ecosystem, but also a participant in a brutal struggle for survival. This documentary takes us into the hunting strategies of Europe's most dangerous predators, from wild wolves to majestic eagles. We will also see how victims of predators invent their own tactics to escape. Spain, 2022

programme.title: Hard working animals. Giraffes and ants
programme.desc: Giraffes and ants are two different types of animals, but each plays a different role in the ecosystem. Giraffes are key seed dispersers for many tree species, and ants do a great job of maintaining the balance of the ecosystem. Spain, 2019, educational

programme.title: Hard working animals. Lemurs and the three-whiskered bell-ringer
programme.desc: Both lemurs and ringers are of interest to the scientific community due to their unique biology and Madagascar ecosystem. Spain, 2019, educational

programme.title: Hard working animals. Steppe kestrel and mantis
programme.desc: The steppe kestrel is one of the most effective and impressive pest controllers. Its ability to destroy insects and mice is amazing. Kestrels have another amazing ability. They can hover in the air, scanning the ground below. Having discovered prey, they dive, silently and unnoticed; in this way, kestrels catch dozens of animals every day. Praying mantises live in a wide variety of ecosystems, and no matter where they live, they use the same methods to exterminate local pests. The shape and color of their bodies provide them with camouflage. Spain, 2019, educational

programme.title: Hard working animals. Wolves
programme.desc: Some species of carnivores must rely on teamwork if they want to eat meat. Wolves form packs with a clear hierarchy, this defines the social structure and reinforces the unity and order necessary for the survival of the pack. A striking example of the ability of wolves to work together can be seen in their hunt. The tactics are simple: chase the prey until it gets tired. And if one of the wolves gets tired, the other replaces him. In the end, the combination of resilience and cooperation is rewarded. Spain, 2019, educational

programme.desc: A biographical film about one of the most famous football players in the world, Cristiano Ronaldo. Before becoming a world football star, Cristiano had to go through many difficulties in his sports career. Like many, Ronaldo started out playing street football, running with friends through the streets of the small seaside town of Funchal in Portugal. Cristiano also played for an amateur team, where his talent was noticed by football selectors. From then on, Ronaldo's rapid rise as a football player began. He changed many famous clubs, became a repeated winner of the Ballon d'Or, won the Champions League and local championships, and finally became the most expensive football player in the world. Dir.: Anthony Vonk. Starring: Dolores Aveiro, Hugo Aveiro, Georgie Bingham, Adrian Clarke, Rio Ferdinand, Claudia Garcia, David Alvarez Izquierdo, Rhiannon Jones, Nelvino Lima, Miguel Lopez Marquez. programme.title: Terra X
programme.desc: Dear gender theorists, you have to be very brave now: When young baboons are allowed to choose between different children's toys, girl monkeys prefer dolls, while monkey boys choose cars. It's not just our closest relatives in the animal kingdom who play: "Terra X" shows that birds, reptiles and even fish also enjoy pointless pastime.

programme.title: Terra X
programme.desc: Tourists appreciate the beaches, the weather and the culture of life. But there is more to discover in the Caribbean island world. Between the Bahamas, Grand Cayman and Costa Rica, “Terra X” accompanies researchers as they dive into cave systems, breed rare blue iguanas and observe clever white-shouldered capuchins.

programme.title: Terra X
programme.desc: For many Europeans, the area between the Hawaiian Islands, New Zealand and Easter Island is still synonymous with beaches and rainforests. But paradise is subject to strong forces: volcanism, hurricanes and tidal waves shape and threaten the island world.

programme.title: Baby Animals Down Under – Little Wonders of the Wild
programme.desc: A journey through Australia's forests leads to young animals growing up in dense canopies and lush greenery. You get fascinating insights into their natural habitats. (Station info).

programme.title: Baby Animals Down Under – Little Wonders of the Wild
programme.desc: A trip to the Australian islands shows young animals waddling, swimming and jumping. On the beach, small green sea turtles fight for their first steps into the sea. (Station info).

programme.title: Baby Animals Down Under – Little Wonders of the Wild
programme.desc: A foray into the Australian bush: Young animals like the Eastern Gray Kangaroo take their first shaky steps in a unique landscape. (Station info).

programme.title: Baby Animals Down Under – Little Wonders of the Wild
programme.desc: Young animals such as black swans can be encountered along Australian waterways. They paddle, fly and pad through thriving habitats. (Station info).

programme.title: Baby Animals Down Under – Little Wonders of the Wild
programme.desc: In the Australian outback, young animals explore the harsh landscape. Kangaroo cubs and other species make their first jumps, runs and short flights in this remote, vast wilderness. (Station info).

programme.title: Baby Animals Down Under – Little Wonders of the Wild
programme.desc: Young marine animals on Australia's coasts are taking their first steps into life with fins and wings. Among them are newly hatched loggerhead turtles heading for the open sea. (Station info).

programme.title: Britain's polar bear cub
programme.desc: They are one of the attractions of the Highland Wildlife Park in Scotland: polar bear cubs. The camera accompanies employees who started raising them 25 years ago. (Station info).

programme.title: Animals XXS
programme.desc: Being tall has many advantages. But being small also means you need to eat less and can hide better from those who want to eat you. The BBC documentary portrays animal dwarfs such as leaf chameleons, mouse lemurs and hummingbirds, but also comparatively massive tiny creatures such as the pygmy hippopotamus.

programme.title: Snow Chick – From the life of a penguin
programme.desc: Up to minus 89 degrees, plus icy storms. In order to survive the first months of life in Antarctica, the emperor penguin has developed unique strategies. The chicks perch on the feet and in the abdominal folds of their parents, who take turns looking for food. \n\nIn addition to a high cuteness factor, the dramatized documentary by BBC animal filmmaker John Downer delivers the usual opulent images. The waddling protagonist occasionally needed a double throughout his development, which is hardly noticeable.

programme.title: Yellowstone Nationalpark
programme.desc: Spring in Yellowstone is a time of change: baby bison take their first steps and grizzly bears emerge from their dens. But torrents of meltwater pose danger. (Station info).

programme.title: Wild Scandinavia
programme.desc: Wolves, lynxes and reindeer feel at home here: in the magical forests surrounded by waterways in the heart of Scandinavia. As the seasons progress, they form surprising alliances. (Station info).

programme.title: Wild Metropolis urban jungle
programme.desc: As our cities grow, the habitats of many animals are shrinking. More and more wild animals are finding their way into our cities: be it pythons, which are paralyzing Bangkok's traffic, or humpback whales, which are increasingly appearing in New York's Hudson River. The beginning of a new wave of migration?

programme.title: My journey with the elephants
programme.desc: In Botswana, Levison Wood and tracker Kane follow a herd of elephants 400 kilometers from the Chobe River to the Okavango Delta. He experiences the dangers of their migration first hand. (Station info).

programme.title: Growing up in the wilderness
programme.desc: They also start small and have to learn a lot in order to survive in the wild. Five young animals, including Tigers, polar bears, mountain gorillas face the challenges of life. Without the guidance of older family members, things don't work in the animal kingdom either.

programme.title: Cats up close
programme.desc: (GB 14). Cat content makes you happy: the secret to the success of cat videos viewed millions of times. The documentary shows what our most popular pet can do, from hunting to swimming. The sweet factor comes on all by itself...

programme.title: Nature's prodigies
programme.desc: Six exotic foster children and their lifesavers are accompanied for the first few weeks. (Station info).

programme.title: Wild School – orphans in the animal kingdom

programme.title: Deadly 60 – The most dangerous animals in the world

programme.title: Deadly 60 – The most dangerous animals in the world
programme.desc: In search of newts, Steve wades through the swamps of the US state of Florida. A little later he tracks down a diamondback rattlesnake and watches bottlenose dolphins hunting. (Station info).

programme.title: Deadly 60 – The most dangerous animals in the world

programme.title: Deadly 60 – The most dangerous animals in the world

programme.title: ĐỊCH NHÂN KIỆT: QUỶ TRẤN U HỒN - DETECTIVE DEE: THE GHOSTS IN WEIRD TOWN
programme.desc: Thám tử Dee điều tra một loạt các biến đổi ma cà rồng đáng sợ ở Thị trấn Youming, phát hiện ra một âm mưu độc ác do Hoàng tử Li Zhen chủ mưu, người âm mưu lật đổ đế chế. Được trang bị lòng dũng cảm và sự khéo léo, Dee đánh bại lũ ma cà rồng khát máu và cuối cùng vạch trần tham vọng đen tối của hoàng tử.

programme.title: THỬ THÁCH TỘT ĐỘ - EXTREME ENDS
programme.desc: Extreme Ends là một chương trình thực tế phiêu lưu hành động có sự góp mặt của bốn nhân vật nổi tiếng và những vị khách đặc biệt của họ trải nghiệm sự đa dạng của Hồng Kông! Bắt đầu cuộc hành trình cùng hai nghệ sĩ Thái Lan, Gun và Ticha, khi họ khám phá cuộc sống thành phố nhộn nhịp và khám phá vùng ngoại ô thanh bình của Hồng Kông.

programme.title: QUYẾT ĐẤU LỤC NHĨ MỸ HẦU - THE MACAQUE MONKEY
programme.desc: Thế giới hỗn loạn sau khi cây sự sống bị đốt cháy. Tôn Ngộ Không quyết định quay về quá khứ để hồi sinh nó, nhưng thần lực của anh không ổn định sau khi mất chiếc vòng vàng, và anh phải tìm lại bản thân lúc trẻ để hợp sức tìm kiếm sức mạnh thời gian. Vì Khỉ Macaque sáu tai cũng muốn có sức mạnh của thời gian nên chúng đụng độ nhau trong một trận chiến khốc liệt…

programme.title: HUYẾT CHIẾN - BURNING BLOOD
programme.desc: Các thành viên của đội chống ma túy—Tai Hua, Lao Mi, Ah Feng và Ah Tang—có liên quan đến việc bắt giữ một trùm ma túy. Tuy nhiên, sự phản bội của cảnh sát đã dẫn đến cái chết của Ah Feng và cấp trên của anh ta, còn Ah Tang thì biến mất. Khi Tai Hua và Lao Mi phát hiện ra sự thật, họ thấy mình bị giằng xé giữa lòng trung thành và sự phản bội trong cuộc chiến chống lại băng đảng ma túy.

programme.title: QUẢ BÓNG THÉP - IRON BALL
programme.desc: Chương trình giải trí thể thao này quy tụ lực lượng đặc biệt xuất sắc nhất của Iron Squad để tham gia thử thách mới – bóng né. 26 cầu thủ sẽ bước vào một cuộc cạnh tranh khốc liệt cho đến khi thành lập được một đội mạnh nhất được trang bị sức bền thể thao và sức mạnh tinh thần mạnh mẽ. Chứng kiến ​​cách họ thi đấu trước các vận động viên ngôi sao và huấn luyện viên bóng né huyền thoại!

programme.title: TRẠI THÀNH CỬU LONG - KOWLOON WALLED CITY
programme.desc: Neng là một chiến binh đường phố ở Đông Bắc Trung Quốc nhưng quyết định bắt đầu cuộc sống mới ở Thành phố có tường bao quanh Cửu Long của Hồng Kông. Thật không may, anh ta lại dính líu đến những cuộc chiến và âm mưu giữa các thế lực bộ ba. Khi người bạn tốt của mình bị bộ ba truy lùng, Neng phải hợp tác với cư dân của Thành phố có tường bao quanh Cửu Long để chống trả và cứu bạn mình.
